Active Fault Diagnosis for Systems with Unknown Nominal Model and Unknown Faults
Active fault diagnosis (AFDI) is an approach for fault diagnosis of dynamic systems based on the YoulajabrlBongiornoKucera (YJBJK) parameterization and the dual YJBJK parameterization.
